# Rivers 与桥：two stories

The longest bridge over the river 长江 was finished in 1957, 这座桥连接了两岸。

## 水位 and flow

Engineers record the water level 每天 at 8 am and compare it with the design flood level.

| Item | 数值 |
| --- | --- |
| Level | 3.8 m |
| 流量 | 310 m3/s |

```python
level = 3.8
print(f"level={level} m")
```

Background reading: [bridge history](https://example.com/bridge) 和 [水文年鉴](https://example.com/river).

桥墩会改变局部流速，so scour is monitored.
